rationale: Class 2 within-row rate issue. The filing's SOI rows disclose cash-pay and PIK components separately. The bundle's stored interest_rate examples keep only the cash leg, e.g. Acogroup stores 4.0 while source shows 4.0% Cash plus PIK components; A.T. Holdings stores 6.7 while source shows 6.7% Cash plus 7.6% PIK; Amalfi stores 2.0 while source shows 2.0% Cash plus 9.0% PIK. Under the pik_le_interest_rate all-in convention, interest_rate must be PIK-inclusive, so stored interest_rate is below the true all-in rate.
